en.name: Microneedling (Collagen Induction Therapy)
en.meta_title: Microneedling: Collagen Induction for Skin Rejuvenation & Scar Repair
en.meta_description: Rejuvenate your skin with microneedling (collagen induction therapy). This treatment stimulates collagen production to improve skin texture, reduce acne scars, minimize pores, and diminish fine lines for a firmer, youthful look.
en.meta_keywords: microneedling, collagen induction therapy, skin rejuvenation, acne scar treatment, pore size reduction, fine line treatment, PRP facial

what_is.heading: What is Microneedling? Rejuvenate Your Skin from Within
paragraphs: Rejuvenate your skin from within with Microneedling, also known as collagen induction therapy. This advanced treatment uses a device with fine, sterile needles to create thousands of controlled micro-injuries in the skin. This process triggers the body's natural wound-healing cascade, resulting in a significant increase in collagen and elastin production.

applications.heading: What Can Microneedling Treat?
paragraphs: Microneedling is highly effective for a wide range of concerns. It can dramatically improve skin texture, reduce the appearance of acne scars and surgical scars, minimize pore size, diminish fine lines and wrinkles, and improve the appearance of stretch marks.

procedure.heading: The Procedure and Enhanced Results
paragraphs: We can enhance the results of microneedling by combining it with the application of potent serums or even your own Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP). The micro-channels created by the needles allow for deeper penetration of these topical treatments. A series of 3-6 treatments is typically recommended for optimal, long-lasting results, revealing smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin.
